desc: 近黑加纸白只留一点薄绿，硬边纸影与发丝网格十字准星，九屏漏斗奶瓶详情
leaf: 宽口圆顶透明防尘罩硅胶奶嘴奶瓶
name: 黑白纸影薄绿准星奶瓶款

shots.intent: 用一整面哑光纸白加硬边平行条纸影与近黑标题线的极简首屏，一次交代磨砂宽身瓶体、透明圆顶罩盖与亮面宽瓶盖环的装配关系，靠版式反差抢到首屏停留与点击
shots.textZone: 上部留白带内一条近黑主标压在一条通长发丝线上，其下一行小一号副标与一枚薄绿小标签，右侧窄薄绿带上一个十字准星加轻量无衬线序号 01

shots.intent: 把源图三枚功效圆环图标和一整版材质健康断言改造成纸面发丝网格上的三个空白准星位，条目全部交给占位符，只留问题框架不复述任何材质与功效
shots.textZone: 顶部一条小标题压通长发丝线加一行小一号副标，其下一条带三个十字准星与序号码的发丝索引线，三个留白 plate 各一行空白标签位

shots.intent: 把源图杜撰的百分比电量条与三段恐吓式正文改成同一纸面被一条近黑发丝线切出的两区留白，右区立本品左区整块空给卖家自贴，杜绝虚构对比与数值
shots.textZone: 顶部一条对照小标题压发丝线与一行小一号副标，左区一整块近黑反白留白块，两区各一条空白标签线挂在十字准星引线上

shots.intent: 把源图露脸母婴对喂实拍与幼儿独自握瓶喝奶实拍改写成纸影边的一双手怀抱场景，成人从肩下取景、婴儿仅后脑且全程被托抱，让买家代入又不越界
仰视微距交代透明圆顶罩盖、亮面宽瓶盖环与坐在瓶口内的带肋奶嘴的装配关系，三枚准星引线撑起做工信任而不写任何结构功效
shots.textZone: 上方一枚空白标签线，左右各一枚空白标签线，左下一行近黑结构小标题压发丝线，条目文字全占位

shots.intent: 正侧面交代宽身短瓶轮廓与三条准星参照引线，把源图自相矛盾的三处 10cm 与 7cm 数值全部改成无字尺寸框，只留空白标签
shots.textZone: 左侧一条无字尺寸示意轨，右侧三行空白标签线挂在十字准星引线上，顶部一行造型小标题压发丝线

shots.intent: 正俯视交代罩盖圆周、瓶盖环与宽口径瓶口的同心装配关系，用真接触面和一枚准星引线证明结构与做工而不写任何尺寸与功效
shots.textZone: 右侧一枚空白标签线挂在十字准星引线上，下方一条带序号码与准星的发丝索引线，上方一行近黑小标题压发丝线

shots.intent: 把源图那串写着法国PP与耐温100的参数条和会员二维码改成六格空白档案加一整块留证位，字段名与数值一律留空，卖家自行合贴真实资料
shots.textZone: 顶部近黑反白小标题与一行小一号副标，其下六行空白档案条目（字段名与数值全空），底部一整块空白留证位，全部条目文字占位

shots.intent: 以三十度俯角在纸影与发丝网格边收口整套近黑白视觉，留出一枚空白行动卡与两枚准星标签，引导语全交给不编造事实的占位符
shots.textZone: 上部留白带放结束标题（压通长发丝线）、一行小一号副标、一枚空白行动卡与两枚空白准星标签线，底部一条带序号码的发丝索引线与近黑收尾块

style.backgroundSystem: one seamless matte paper sweep #F6F7F4 with a fine fibre tooth and a single soft horizon curve, across which a geometric cutter throws hard-edged parallel-bar and rectangular shadow shapes, so depth comes only from those crisp shadow planes and from the paper curve; flat layout and infographic screens are built on the same paper field ruled with thin near-black #14171A hairline grid lines, one narrow mint #47D3A5 band edging the active column and solid near-black #14171A blocks reserved for reversal; never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never a stone or micro-cement slab, never a walnut or any wood tabletop, never a linen or fabric basket, never a glass sheet or water studio, never a podium disc, never a tangent sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a pastel colour block wall and never a dark or metallic field
style.direction: near-black and paper-white minimal maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce with one mint accent
style.iconSystem: thin crosshair plus-marks on hairline grid lines only: every index marker, every callout endpoint and every grid intersection is a small plus drawn from two crossed single-weight hairlines, in near-black #14171A on the paper field and in mint #47D3A5 on a solid near-black block, at one single size and one single stroke weight across the whole set; a callout is one hairline leader that leaves the referenced part at a right angle, centres one crosshair exactly on that part and runs out to a completely empty label line; the index bar is one continuous thin rule carrying evenly spaced crosshairs and small light sans ordinal digits; never a rounded-square squircle chip, never a copper or metal ring, never a filled circular stamp or knocked-out glyph medallion, never a square tick, never a dotted circle or dot ring, never a three-dot pagination marker, never a triangular pennant flag, never a dashed square-chain leader, never a bare oversized serif numeral, never a pill or capsule badge, never a medal, rosette, star, shield or sunburst, never a second line weight and no pictogram artwork at all
style.lightingSystem: one large diffuse source at about 5000K placed directly overhead and a few degrees behind the camera axis, fitted with a geometric cutter so the lit paper stays perfectly even while every shadow edge stays hard and readable: the dome crest carries one broad soft top highlight, the left flank one narrow specular hairline, the base one tight dark contact shadow sitting directly under it and the object shadow falling short toward the camera-near side; contrast medium, surfaces matte with no mirror reflection; strictly the same overhead light direction in every screen, never a long side-raked shadow, never a low warm key from camera right, never a cool front-top wash and never a backlit rim-only set-up
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent near-black, paper-white and single-mint maternal-infant feeding bottle commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte paper sweep #F6F7F4 and shadow grey #C6CCC6 as bases with near-black #14171A carrying every block, rule and headline and exactly one mint accent #47D3A5; neutral diffuse tone at about 5000K throughout; background system limited to one seamless matte paper sweep with a fine fibre tooth and a single soft horizon curve across which a geometric cutter throws hard-edged parallel-bar and rectangular shadow shapes, flat layout screens built on the same paper ruled with thin near-black #14171A hairline grid lines, one narrow mint #47D3A5 band and solid near-black reversal blocks, never limewash plaster, never an arched niche, never a stone or micro-cement slab, never a walnut or any wood tabletop, never a linen or fabric basket, never a glass sheet or water studio, never a podium disc, never a tangent sphere cluster, never a gradient card, never a pastel block wall and never a dark or metallic field; one large diffuse 5000K source placed directly overhead and a few degrees behind the camera axis and fitted with a geometric cutter so the lit paper stays even while every shadow edge stays hard, the dome crest carrying one broad soft top highlight, the left flank one narrow specular hairline, the base one tight dark contact shadow directly under it and the cast shadow falling short toward the camera-near side, medium contrast, matte surfaces with no mirror reflection, the same overhead light direction in every screen, never a long side-raked shadow and never a low warm or cool key from camera right; one modern geometric Chinese sans family set flush left on the hairline grid, a single short headline in near-black #14171A sitting directly on one thin full-width hairline rule, one short sub-line a size step smaller, at most one small mint #47D3A5 label and paper #F6F7F4 reversal on a solid near-black block, no Latin overprint, no wide-tracked small-caps kicker, no serif, no highlighter band, no boxed headline frame, one short line of copy only; icon system of thin crosshair plus-marks on hairline grid lines only, every marker being a small plus of two crossed single-weight hairlines in near-black #14171A on paper or mint #47D3A5 on a black block at one size and one weight, each callout one hairline leader leaving the part at a right angle, centring one crosshair exactly on it and running to a completely empty label line, never a squircle chip, never a copper or metal ring, never a filled circular stamp, never a square tick, never a dotted circle or dot ring, never a three-dot pagination marker, never a triangular pennant, never a dashed square-chain leader, never a bare oversized serif numeral, never a pill badge, never a medal, rosette, star or shield and no pictogram artwork at all; the short wide frosted bottle stands upright at a stable scale with the tall clear dome overcap fitted, the collar ring screwed closed and the nipple fully seated inside, the shoulder flare, rounded base, dome height, small apex protrusion, the band reading approximately #7B6A6C under the ring, the inner seal ring at the neck and the collar ring at its exact reference tone reading approximately #E9A2AC never redrawn, the single reference colourway being the only colourway so no second tone, straw insert, handle ring or spare nipple is ever invented, any graduation marking kept exactly as shot and any label area left as one blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm or cool cast, no stone, arch, wood or fabric, no new product colors, no invented numbers.
noDrift: no medical or functional-benefit wording of any kind: no anti-colic claim, no 「防胀气」 「不胀气」 「防呛」 「不倒流」, no air-intake, valve, filtration or digestion assertion, no 「科学证明」 research endorsement and no mechanism caption that implies a health result
no breastfeeding-equivalence or mother-feeling wording: no 「母乳实感」 「妈妈的感觉」 「像亲喂一样自然」 「仿母乳」 and no soothing or mother-substitute phrasing
no leak or performance conclusion: no 「专业防漏」 「倒置不漏水」 「不漏奶」 statement, no inverted-water test, no droplet, no splash and no ring of arrows implying a sealed result
no age or stage indication: no 「新生儿」 「专为新生婴儿设计」 「0-7个月」 「7个月以上」, no month or year range, no lung-capacity statement and no wording about who the product suits

no material or safety-grade claim: no 「PPSU」 「PA材质」 「玻璃」 「中硼硅」 「食品级硅胶」 「食品级材质」 「法国PP」 「PP」 「PES」, no BPA-free or 「不含双酚A」 「不含双酚S」 statement, no 「健康」 「安全无异味」 「耐摔」 「坚韧耐摔」 assertion and no surface-performance claim
no heat, sterilisation or disinfection standard: no 「耐温180」 「耐温100」, no temperature or hour figure, no 「可消毒」 「杀菌」 「抑菌」, no sterilisation rate, no cycle count and no pathogen or organism name

no certification or endorsement artwork: no FDA mark, no certificate, award, medal, seal, inspection report, authorisation letter, registration or filing number or execution-standard code, and no doctor, hospital, midwife or laboratory endorsement
no origin or import claim: no 「欧洲进口品质」 「瑞士进口」 「英国生产」, no country name, no landmark or castle photograph, no flag artwork and no factory, supplier or heritage wording

no invented numbers anywhere: no 「7cm」 or any mouth diameter, no capacity in millilitres, no dimension, no net weight, no pack or piece count, no shelf life, no 「三大」 or 「6大」 count, no multiple, no percentage, no progress bar and no chart
no price, discount, coupon, countdown, gift, free-shipping or delivery-time wording, no sales count, rating, review score or award claim
no brand, store or material-site residue: no 「DW」 「大卫先生素材」 「MR. DAVY MATERIAL」 wordmark, no stock-library watermark, no corner tag, no platform badge, no 「加入会员」 「全店免费」 membership block and no QR code

no feeding-infant faces and no bottle at a child mouth: any infant appears only from behind or cropped above the jaw, is always held and fully supervised by an anonymous adult framed from the shoulders down with anatomically correct hands, and the bottle is never left unattended, never resting on a child and never at the lips

no loose, unsecured, detached, hanging or exploded nipple, collar ring or overcap: the nipple stays seated and closed inside the dome in every screen, no open ring and no part suspended in air, and no inverted bottle is ever shown
no microwave, no steam, no vapour on skin, no hot liquid touching skin and no pouring water anywhere in the set

no style drift between screens: no palette change, no mixed fonts, no limewash plaster, no arched niche, no stone or micro-cement slab, no walnut or any wood tabletop, no linen or fabric basket, no glass-and-water studio, no podium disc, no sphere cluster, no gradient card, no pastel block wall, no squircle chip, no copper ring, no square tick, no dotted circle, no pennant flag and no bare serif numeral, no inconsistent light direction, no recoloured product and no invented second colourway
style.presentationRules: the short wide frosted bottle stands upright at a stable scale on the paper sweep with the tall clear dome overcap fitted, the wide collar ring screwed closed and the nipple fully seated and secured inside the dome; the body silhouette from shoulder flare to rounded base, the base radius, the dome height and its small apex protrusion, the dark band reading approximately #7B6A6C directly under the collar ring, the inner seal ring visible at the neck, the glossy collar ring at its exact reference tone reading approximately #E9A2AC and the ribbed nipple flange are never redrawn, relocated or resized; the reference shows one single colourway, so no second colourway, no straw insert, no handle ring, no spare nipple and no accessory is ever invented or added to any screen; any graduation marking on the body stays exactly as shot and is never added, removed or resized; the label area always reads as one blank legible field carrying no redrawn wording; the product never floats without its contact shadow, is never occluded by props or by a shadow shape, vertical lines stay vertical, one real unmarked object anchors scale inside every scene shot, and the hard shadow shapes never cross a product silhouette so as to read as a seam on it
style.surfaceSystem: matte fibrous paper sweep #F6F7F4 as the only standing surface, the frosted bottle body settling onto it with one true narrow contact shadow plus one crisp-edged cast shadow shape, a shallow paper-dust matte finish rather than any reflection; the clear overcap renders as true refractive plastic with one broad top highlight and one narrow flank specular, the glossy collar ring as a soft satin sheen with a readable step edge, the nipple inside the dome as real elastomer with soft internal shading, never as hard glossy rubber
style.typography: one modern geometric Chinese sans family throughout, set flush left on a hairline grid; a single short headline in near-black #14171A sitting directly on one thin full-width near-black hairline rule, one short sub-line in the same family a size step smaller, and at most one small mint #47D3A5 label; on a solid near-black block the same headline reverses to paper #F6F7F4; section titles repeat the headline-plus-rule device at a smaller size; one short line of copy only, no dense body text, no Latin overprint words, no wide-tracked small-caps kicker strips, no serif, no handwritten or cartoon lettering, no keyword highlighter band, no boxed headline frame, no mixed fonts
